verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API, which gives some programmatic, non-GUI access usable from automation. It also advertises remote script execution and automated recurring fixes as endpoint-management features. Nothing shows the product itself running headlessly in a CI pipeline, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CLI mode, CI integration guidance or examples, a machine-readable API spec, and hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
